models.description: Careful reasoning. For problems worth working through: maths, logic, trade-offs, debugging an argument. Slower, and shows its working.
models.licenseNote: Very permissive — do almost anything as long as the copyright notice is kept.

models.name: Arc Code
models.author: ArcFlare
models.description: Coding agent. Built for the ArcFlare agent and coding harnesses: reads before it edits, makes small changes, and tests what it built.
models.licenseNote: Very permissive — do almost anything as long as the copyright notice is kept.

models.name: Arc Desk
models.author: ArcFlare
models.description: Operates the desktop. Sees the screen and uses the mouse and keyboard through ArcFlare's desktop server. Needs a base model that reads images.
models.licenseNote: Permissive — commercial use, modification, and distribution allowed, with attribution and a patent grant.
